line_items.description: Dry-Aged Smoked Duck Breast with Fermented Plum

reasoning: Client hospitality dinner for 4, including 3 external guests from CloudScale Systems, qualifies for the €90-per-attendee dinner cap, so the €247 invoice is within the €360 cap. The three Mezcalita cocktails count against the client-hospitality alcohol allowance of 30% of the €178.50 non-alcoholic food and drink subtotal; at €43.50 they sit within the €53.55 allowance, so they are reimbursed in full. The truffle risotto passes the Figure 3 screening as a main course at €23 per portion, below the €40 threshold. The German 20% tip cap allows the full €25.00 tip on the €222.00 pre-tip bill. Nothing is deducted, so the invoice is approved in full.
